overview: The School Committee discussed space utilization options to address elementary school overcrowding, voting to table a proposal to restructure K-8 schools until their next meeting to gather public input. The Committee also approved resolutions regarding annual 504 plan notices and voter registration initiatives, and received updates on career and technical education grants and high school bus stop adjustments.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included meeting minutes, grants, and field trips.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Andrews Middle School Spirit Week
items.summary: Students and administration from Andrews Middle School presented on their student-led spirit week activities aimed at fostering a sense of belonging.

items.title: Student Advisory Council Presentation on Transportation
items.summary: The committee received a presentation on proposed high school bus stop railings to improve student boarding, and discussed sending a feedback survey to students.

items.title: Career and Technical Education Grants Update
items.summary: Received an informational update on the district's career and technical education grant funding, including awards for new programming development and automotive equipment upgrades.

items.title: HMFH Space Utilization Study and School Restructuring
items.summary: Tabled a recommendation to restructure schools into K-4, 5-6, and 7-8 grade spans to the December 1st meeting, inviting public input on the scope of the proposed transition task force.

items.title: Resolution 2025-36: Annual 504 Plan Notices
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing administration to send yearly informational notices to families regarding 504 plans and eligibility requirements.

items.title: Resolution 2025-37: Student Voter Engagement
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution to collaborate with the registrar of voters and the student advisory council to improve student voter registration and education.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Read condolences and observed a moment of silence for retired staff and former city officials.

subject: Elementary School Overcrowding and Space Utilization
